description: Require explicit structured publication before a sync-enabled analysis ends.

hooks.prompt: If the user requested that this analysis be synchronized to Smart Data Agent and no successful `SDA publish --channel workbuddy` command has been run in this conversation, return {"ok":false,"reason":"请先按 smart-data-agent-report Skill 生成结构化报告并执行 SDA publish；不要上传整段对话转录。"}. Otherwise return {"ok":true}.
